events.text: Hi! I'd like to plan a day hike in Picos de Europa with my friend Bob sometime in the next two weeks. Nothing too extreme, my knee isn't great on long descents. Can you sort it out?
Heads-up: my friend Alice is planning a hike for the two of us. I can only do weekends.
